{{Quotation|game|The great dragon prophet, [[Glint]], is not easy to find, for she uses powerful magics to make her lair inside a single crystalline grain of sand. A person could search a hundred lifetimes and never find the exact grain. The only true entrance is through this portal, beyond the challenges of [[Augury Rock (outpost)|Augury Rock]].}}

[[The Dragon's Lair (outpost)|The Dragon's Lair]] is a [[mission]] [[outpost]]. It is the home and sanctuary to Glint and her [[Forgotten]].

This area functions as a lobby for organizing party expeditions into [[Tomb of the Primeval Kings]].

==Getting There==
*The mission [[Augury Rock]] will bring you here.

==Mission==
*[[The Dragon's Lair]]
**This mission is the nineteenth mission in the [[Prophecies campaign]] and the fifth and last mission in the [[Crystal Desert]] region.
